## Standing operator rules
- Separate from the main session goal, also run `billing_amount_migration` between other work, safely without downtime/data loss; run all eight listed steps in order, one at a time.
- Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in `requirements/license-tools.txt`, never `>=` or floating latest.
- Never remove a response field from ledgerly; mark it deprecated and retain it for at least 180 days after its first deprecation notice.
- Active schema is `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Production DB: `billing`; active schema: `billing_v3`; frozen schema: `billing_v1` (superseded as active). `current_request_id`; `Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]`; pagination dropped.

## Ruled-out approaches
Increasing Celery visibility timeout to six hours: stuck jobs became invisible for hours. Direct DB-session defaults caused four Ruff B008 findings. Direct `print()` lacked logging context. Legacy invoice-rounding fixture failure was unrelated and left unchanged.

## Plan and progress
Migration steps 1–5 done: nullable column, 184,263-row backfill, mismatch check, and `SET NOT NULL`. Steps 6–8 pending; next command was not supplied. Webhook signature fix is pending. No issued command lacks an observed result.

## Recent work
Added and verified `tests/test_currency_rounding.py` (6 tests, 91% line coverage), including half-cent, negative, scale, input-type, zero, high-precision, and invalid-scale cases. Full suite: 184 passed, 2 skipped. Ruff and whitespace checks passed.
